info:

سـ + present verb → future
سأكتب = I will write
سيكتب = he will write
سنكتب = we will write

For negative future, MSA uses:

لن + present verb
لن أكتب = I will not write
لن يكون = it/he will not be

However, in everyday dialects, future forms vary considerably.
native_answer: I will get a gift.
